text: {"lessons":["My account dipped before recovering, so I should not let a few monthly moves trigger reactive trades or assume recent gains will continue.","I added shares across all five stocks at different prices; before buying more, I should check each holding's size, available cash, and overall concentration rather than automatically adding to everything.","With an apartment goal less than ten years away, I should invest consistently while keeping a cash reserve and periodically review whether my risk and allocation still fit that timeline."]}
